# Team Progress Dashboard — Spec Lite

A new admin-only page that groups AI Trail participants by team, showing per-team badge-level breakdowns via stacked progress bars, expandable member tables with drill-down links, and "stalled" indicators for participants who haven't submitted evidence or advanced in 14+ days. Accessible at `/admin/teams` with a team name search filter.
